problem: 列出所有在2024年12月发生过交易且交易对手方类型为'银行'的交易ID和对手方名称，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT t.transaction_id, cp.counterparty_name FROM transactions t JOIN counterparties cp ON t.counterparty_id = cp.counterparty_id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(t.trade_date, '%Y-%m') = '2024-12' AND cp.counterparty_type = '银行';

problem: 查询所有投资组合中，当前市值与累计投入金额之比（即收益率+1）最高的组合代码和该比率，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT portfolio_code, current_value / contribution_amount AS ratio FROM portfolios WHERE contribution_amount > 0 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 找出所有客户中，联系信息里的地址包含'北京'关键字的客户姓名，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT client_name FROM clients WHERE contact_info LIKE '%北京%';

problem: 找出所有客户经理中绩效评分最高的前三名的姓名和分数。 (变体 91)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_name, performance_score FROM managers ORDER BY performance_score DESC LIMIT 3;

problem: 麻烦列出所有在'风险管理部'工作的客户经理姓名及其绩效评分。 (变体 92)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_name, performance_score FROM managers WHERE department_name = '风险管理部';

problem: 找出所有产品中，在2022年成立的QDII类产品名称和成立日期。 (变体 93)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT product_name, inception_date FROM products WHERE YEAR(inception_date) = 2022 AND product_type = 'QDII';

problem: 找出所有客户经理入职日期在2022年之后且职级为'经理'或'高级经理'的人员姓名和部门。 (变体 94)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_name, department_name FROM managers WHERE hire_date > '2021-12-31' AND position_level IN ('经理', '高级经理');

problem: 请显示所有交易金额大于10万元且状态为'已成'的交易ID和净额。 (变体 95)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT transaction_id, net_amount FROM transactions WHERE transaction_amount > 100000 AND status = '已成';

problem: 找出所有客户经理上级ID不为空的经理姓名及其上级经理姓名。 (变体 97)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_name, s.manager_name AS superior_name FROM managers m JOIN managers s ON m.superior_id = s.manager_id WHERE m.superior_id IS NOT NULL;

problem: 找出所有客户经理管理资产总额排名前10%的经理ID和姓名。 (变体 98)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_id, manager_name FROM (SELECT manager_id, manager_name, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY manage_assets_total DESC) AS pr FROM managers) t WHERE pr <= 0.1;

problem: 列出所有客户经理及其所属部门的名称，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_name, department_name FROM managers;

problem: 找出每个客户的第一个投资组合的代码和成立日期，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT client_id, portfolio_id, portfolio_code, inception_date FROM (SELECT client_id, portfolio_id, portfolio_code, inception_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY client_id ORDER BY inception_date ASC, portfolio_id ASC) AS rn FROM portfolios) t WHERE rn = 1;

problem: 统计每个产品类型的平均管理费率，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT product_type, AVG(management_fee) AS avg_fee FROM products GROUP BY product_type;

problem: 找出所有交易金额超过100000的买入交易，并显示其组合代码和交易日期，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT p.portfolio_code, t.trade_date FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON t.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id WHERE t.transaction_amount > 100000 AND t.transaction_type = '买入';

problem: 统计每个客户经理管理的客户总数，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT manager_id, manager_name, client_count AS total_client_cnt FROM managers;

problem: 列出所有触发了预警的风险记录对应的组合代码和计算日期，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.portfolio_code, rm.calc_date FROM risk_metrics rm JOIN portfolios p ON rm.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id WHERE rm.is_alert = TRUE;

problem: 找出所有在2024年有过交易的组合代码，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.portfolio_code FROM portfolios p JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024;

problem: 列出所有债券型产品及其基准指数，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT product_name, benchmark_index FROM products WHERE product_type = '债券型';

problem: 统计每个对手方类型的交易次数，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT cp.counterparty_type, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS trade_cnt FROM transactions t JOIN counterparties cp ON t.counterparty_id = cp.counterparty_id GROUP BY cp.counterparty_type;

problem: 列出所有个人客户的姓名和联系方式（电话号码），请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT client_name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(contact_info, '$.phone')) AS phone FROM clients WHERE client_type = '个人';

problem: 统计每种客户类型的客户数量，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT client_type, COUNT(*) AS client_cnt FROM clients GROUP BY client_type;

problem: 找出所有在2023年注册且状态为正常的客户信息，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT * FROM clients WHERE YEAR(register_date) = 2023 AND status = 1;

problem: 列出所有已终止的投资组合（显示组合代码、客户ID和终止日期），请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT portfolio_code, client_id, termination_date FROM portfolios WHERE termination_date IS NOT NULL;

problem: 计算每个产品的平均管理费率，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT product_id, AVG(management_fee) AS avg_fee FROM products GROUP BY product_id;

problem: 找出所有风险评级为5级的有效产品，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE risk_rating = 5 AND is_active = 1;

problem: 查询所有“银行”类型的对手方，并按注册资本降序排列，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT * FROM counterparties WHERE counterparty_type = '银行' ORDER BY registered_capital DESC;

problem: 统计每个部门的客户经理人数，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT department_name, COUNT(*) AS manager_cnt FROM managers GROUP BY department_name;

problem: 找出所有夏普比率大于1的投资组合，并显示其当前市值和创建用户，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.current_value, p.create_user FROM portfolios p JOIN risk_metrics rm ON p.portfolio_id = rm.portfolio_id WHERE rm.sharp_ratio > 1;

problem: 找出每个客户风险等级下，最大回撤超过其组合限制的组合，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.risk_level, p.portfolio_code FROM clients c JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN risk_metrics rm ON p.portfolio_id = rm.portfolio_id WHERE rm.max_drawdown > p.max_drawdown_limit;

problem: 统计每个部门的客户经理所管理客户的总交易金额，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.department_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id GROUP BY m.department_name;

problem: 找出所有在2025年Q3有交易、但当前无持仓的产品，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.product_id FROM transactions t WHERE t.trade_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' AND t.product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM holdings);

problem: 找出所有客户-组合-交易-对手方链条中，对手方信用评级为'D'的交易记录，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT t.transaction_id, cp.counterparty_name FROM clients c JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id JOIN counterparties cp ON t.counterparty_id = cp.counterparty_id WHERE cp.credit_rating = 'D';

problem: 列出每个客户的名字、风险等级以及他们持有的所有投资组合的总当前市值，并按总市值降序排列，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_name, c.risk_level, COALESCE(SUM(p.current_value), 0) AS total_value FROM clients c LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.client_name, c.risk_level ORDER BY total_value DESC;

problem: 查询每个客户经理管理的所有客户在2024年的总交易金额（买入+卖出），请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_id, m.manager_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.transaction_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id AND YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 GROUP BY m.manager_id, m.manager_name;

problem: 找出每个客户类型下，平均单个投资组合的当前市值，并筛选出平均市值最高的客户类型，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT client_type, AVG(value_per_portfolio) AS avg_value FROM (SELECT c.client_type, p.current_value AS value_per_portfolio FROM clients c JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id) t GROUP BY client_type ORDER BY avg_value DESC LIMIT 1;

problem: 查询所有在2024年有交易记录且其交易对手方信用评级低于'A'的投资组合代码和对手方名称，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.portfolio_code, cp.counterparty_name FROM portfolios p JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id JOIN counterparties cp ON t.counterparty_id = cp.counterparty_id WHERE YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 AND cp.credit_rating < 'A';

problem: 列出所有客户经理姓名、部门以及他们管理的客户中风险等级为'进取'的客户数量，按数量降序排列，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_name, m.department_name, COUNT(c.client_id) AS aggressive_client_cnt FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id AND c.risk_level = '进取' GROUP BY m.manager_id, m.manager_name, m.department_name ORDER BY aggressive_client_cnt DESC;

problem: 查询每个产品类型的平均30天滚动交易金额（买入+卖出），并按平均金额降序排列，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT pr.product_type, AVG(t.transaction_amount) AS avg_amount FROM transactions t JOIN products pr ON t.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE t.trade_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY pr.product_type ORDER BY avg_amount DESC;

problem: 列出所有客户中，在2024年有交易但在2025年没有交易的客户姓名和ID，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.client_name FROM clients c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM portfolios p JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE p.client_id = c.client_id AND YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM portfolios p JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id WHERE p.client_id = c.client_id AND YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2025);

problem: 列出所有客户经理姓名、职级以及他们管理的客户在2024年的总佣金收入（所有交易的佣金费总和），请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_name, m.position_level, COALESCE(SUM(t.commission_fee), 0) AS total_commission FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id AND YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 GROUP BY m.manager_id, m.manager_name, m.position_level;

problem: 查询每个部门管理的客户总资产规模总和，并按总规模降序排列，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.department_name, COALESCE(SUM(c.total_assets), 0) AS total_assets FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id GROUP BY m.department_name ORDER BY total_assets DESC;

problem: 列出所有在2024年有'买入'交易且在2025年有'卖出'同一产品的客户姓名和产品名称，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_name, pr.product_name FROM clients c JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN transactions t1 ON p.portfolio_id = t1.portfolio_id AND t1.transaction_type = '买入' AND YEAR(t1.trade_date) = 2024 JOIN transactions t2 ON p.portfolio_id = t2.portfolio_id AND t2.transaction_type = '卖出' AND YEAR(t2.trade_date) = 2025 AND t2.product_id = t1.product_id JOIN products pr ON t1.product_id = pr.product_id;

problem: 查询所有投资组合中，其最大回撤（从风险指标表获取）超过其设定的最大回撤限制的投资组合代码、实际最大回撤和限制值，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT p.portfolio_code, rm.max_drawdown, p.max_drawdown_limit FROM portfolios p JOIN risk_metrics rm ON p.portfolio_id = rm.portfolio_id WHERE rm.max_drawdown > p.max_drawdown_limit;

problem: 列出所有客户经理姓名、职级以及他们管理的客户在2024年的总佣金收入（所有交易的佣金费总和）。 (变体 100)，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_name, m.position_level, COALESCE(SUM(t.commission_fee), 0) AS total_commission FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN transactions t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id AND YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 GROUP BY m.manager_id, m.manager_name, m.position_level;

problem: 查询每个客户的风险等级以及他们拥有的投资组合数量，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.risk_level, COUNT(p.portfolio_id) AS portfolio_cnt FROM clients c LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.risk_level;

problem: 找出每个客户经理管理的所有客户的总资产规模之和，并按总规模降序排列，只显示前10名，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_id, m.manager_name, COALESCE(SUM(c.total_assets), 0) AS total_assets FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id GROUP BY m.manager_id, m.manager_name ORDER BY total_assets DESC LIMIT 10;

problem: 列出所有在2024年有过交易记录的投资组合代码、客户名称和交易总金额，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT p.portfolio_code, c.client_name, SUM(t.transaction_amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions t JOIN portfolios p ON t.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id WHERE YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 GROUP BY p.portfolio_code, c.client_name;

problem: 找出每个客户经理所管理的客户中，单个客户总资产最高的客户名称和资产规模，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_id, m.manager_name, c.client_name, c.total_assets FROM managers m LEFT JOIN clients c ON m.manager_id = c.manager_id AND c.total_assets = (SELECT MAX(c2.total_assets) FROM clients c2 WHERE c2.manager_id = m.manager_id);

problem: 统计2024年每个季度各类产品类型的交易净额（买入金额-卖出金额），并按产品类型和季度排序，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT pr.product_type, QUARTER(t.trade_date) AS q, SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = '买入' THEN t.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = '卖出' THEN t.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_amount FROM transactions t JOIN products pr ON t.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE YEAR(t.trade_date) = 2024 GROUP BY pr.product_type, QUARTER(t.trade_date) ORDER BY pr.product_type, q;

problem: 查询所有处于预警状态（is_alert=TRUE）的投资组合的客户名称、组合代码以及最新的最大回撤值，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_name, p.portfolio_code, rm.max_drawdown AS latest_max_drawdown FROM risk_metrics rm JOIN portfolios p ON rm.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id WHERE rm.is_alert = TRUE AND rm.calc_date = (SELECT MAX(calc_date) FROM risk_metrics WHERE portfolio_id = rm.portfolio_id AND is_alert = TRUE);

problem: 列出所有客户经理及其直接上级经理的姓名。如果上级是总经理，则显示部门名称，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT m.manager_name, CASE WHEN s.position_level = '总经理' THEN s.department_name ELSE s.manager_name END AS superior_info FROM managers m LEFT JOIN managers s ON m.superior_id = s.manager_id;

problem: 查询每个客户的总资产（来自clients表）与其所有投资组合的当前总市值（来自portfolios表）之间的差额，并找出差额绝对值最大的前5个客户，请输出对应SQL语句
sql: SELECT c.client_id, c.client_name, c.total_assets - COALESCE(SUM(p.current_value), 0) AS diff FROM clients c LEFT JOIN portfolios p ON c.client_id = p.client_id GROUP BY c.client_id, c.client_name, c.total_assets ORDER BY ABS(c.total_assets - COALESCE(SUM(p.current_value), 0)) DESC LIMIT 5;
